# Luca Finnis-Bernard

> Official information about Luca Finnis-Bernard, a Great Britain U18 alpine ski racer and BASI Ski UK Level 2 instructor.

Luca Finnis-Bernard is a Great Britain U18 alpine ski racer, BASI Ski UK Level 2 instructor, and SnowShepherd Pro Team athlete. He races slalom and giant slalom for Hemel Ski Race Club and is based in the UK.

## Profile

- Official website: https://lucafinnisbernard.co.uk/
- About page: https://lucafinnisbernard.co.uk/about.html
- Markdown profile: https://lucafinnisbernard.co.uk/about.md

## Verified details

- Category: Great Britain U18.
- Disciplines: slalom and giant slalom.
- Qualification: BASI Ski UK Level 2.
- Race club: Hemel Ski Race Club.
- Team: SnowShepherd Pro Team.
- Training and racing venues: The Snow Centre and Snozone.
- Mountain-racing experience: Tignes.
- Teaching venues: The Snow Centre in Hemel Hempstead and Knockhatch Adventure Park.

## Race record

The site records 11 races, 1 win, 7 podiums, 11 top-ten finishes, 8 slalom starts, and 3 giant slalom starts.
